name: Aerosun Corporation
summary: Aerosun Corporation, headquartered in Nanjing, China, since its establishment in 1999, operates as a comprehensive manufacturer and global supplier. The company's core business involves the production and distribution of specialized vehicles. This includes various fuel transportation units, such as aircraft and oil refuellers, alongside an extensive range of sanitation equipment. The latter category features products like compression garbage trucks, garbage dump trucks, detachable container systems, road sweepers, washing and flushing vehicles, high-pressure washing units, and sewerage and fertilizer collection vehicles. Beyond vehicles, Aerosun provides flexible pipeline solutions, notably expansion joints and reinforced thermoplastic piping. Its offerings also extend to pressure vessel products and materials for art engineering projects. Furthermore, the company manufactures metal hoses, which are utilized in diverse fields including the automotive industry, air conditioning systems, construction, gas distribution, and decorative applications. In addition, Aerosun is actively engaged in the research, development, and production of advanced technological products, such as mobile satellite communication systems and laser gyroscopes.
